BiblicalUsage: Paul lists the diversities of operations in 1 Corinthians 12:6 and the working of miracles in 1 Corinthians 12:10 — different workings, but the same God working all in all.
TheologicalSignificance: To me, God's workings come in many shapes, and the variety in His people is His design, not His accident.
